title: Phase 1: Thrive Together
official: Phase 1: Thrive Together: A Feasibility and Acceptability Evaluation of Peer Mentoring for High Schoolers With ADHD and Their Caregivers
summary: During this first phase of the study, the investigators are conducting focus group to conduct a needs assessment. Specifically, the investigators will be holding focus groups with adolescents with ADHD as well as separate focus groups with the adolescents' parents to better understand the current needs of youth with ADHD and how to best support them.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of ADHD diagnosis
* English speaking
* Resident of MA
* available on date of focus group

Exclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of Intellectual Disability (ID)
* Clinical diagnosis of Autism Spectrum Disorder
* in Department of Children and Families custody
* Caregiver not available
